verdict.rationale: First-party docs show schedules that define who is on call, with rotations and chosen participants, and the on-call page claims support for configurations from single-team rotations to shadow schedules and follow-the-sun. Supporting features include working-hours rules on escalation paths and importing holidays/PTO alongside schedule shifts. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of schedule layers, round-robin coverage, explicit time-zone configuration (only implied by follow-the-sun), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
